current_reading_policy: File entries default to data: existing allowlisted passive metadata and bounded opaque chart retention yield partial; explicit strict/legacy policies retain prior rules. Historical default-chart rejection below refers to explicit legacy policy. No unknown records or incomplete worksheets are skipped.

pure_table_unicode_sources.title: MS-XLS CodePage 2.4.52
pure_table_unicode_sources.used_for: Code-page declaration is not restricted by the format to 1200; this implementation explicitly allows 932/936/1252 only in data mode.

pure_table_unicode_sources.title: Microsoft CODEPG reference
pure_table_unicode_sources.used_for: 932,936,1252 identities; no runtime codec or byte-decoding fallback.

pure_table_unicode_sources.title: MS-XLS XLUnicodeString 2.5.294
pure_table_unicode_sources.used_for: Only fHighByte chooses low-byte/full UTF16 storage; seven reserved bits MUST be ignored. Applied only to plain fields, not SST/short/Continue flags.

pure_table_unicode_sources.title: MS-XLS String 2.4.268
pure_table_unicode_sources.used_for: Formula text cache uses XLUnicodeString; no rich-cache layout inferred.

pure_table_unicode_sources.title: MS-XLS Format 2.4.126
pure_table_unicode_sources.used_for: stFormat is XLUnicodeString, length1..255; preserving text is not full format ABNF validation.
